messages:
Alex: Quick heads up — opened docs PR #432 to add Rust SDK snippet for embeddings. Netlify preview is missing the generated snippet file so the page shows 'example not found'. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432
Maria: saw that, Netlify build log shows artifact upload error. Can you paste the netlify preview link? :eyes:
Alex: Preview: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/5f... . Here's the tail of the log:
```
10:12:34 AM: Failed to upload artifact: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open './site/assets/snippets/rust-embed.md'
10:12:34 AM: Build failed: failed to upload build artifacts
```
Devon: I think the mkdocs build step writes snippets to /tmp during CI but our netlify build ignores that because of the parallel artifact step. I hit this locally — running `make docs-build` then `mkdocs serve` shows the snippet.
Jamie: cc @Maria @Alex — two quick options: 1) modify build to copy snippets into docs/ before artifact stage; 2) adjust Netlify build to run the snippet generator as part of the build command. Which is faster for you?
Alex: 1) is easiest for now. I'll push a tiny CI patch that copies generated files into docs/assets/snippets/ before artifact upload. Also adding a note to PR describing local repro steps.
ci-bot: Deploy queued for preview #5f... (status: failed)
Maria: If you do the copy, we should hold merge until the next morning to avoid the long preview queue at midnight. Suggest merge window 10:00-11:30 PDT tomorrow — less load on Netlify. :calendar:
Alex: sounds good. I'll open WIP patch in the same PR and ping for review when ready. ETA ~40m.
Jamie: For reviewers — if you want to test locally: 
```
# regenerate snippets
./scripts/gen-sdk-snippets.sh rust
# build site locally
make docs-build && mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000
# or to emulate netlify artifact step
cp -r site/* /tmp/netlify-artifacts/ && tar -czf artifacts.tar.gz -C /tmp/netlify-artifacts .
```
Devon: adding reminder: if you see caching issues, clear `~/.cache/mkdocs` and `node_modules/.cache` before `make docs-build`.
Maria: ack. @Alex ping us here when ready and we'll queue review during the window. :thumbsup:
Alex: pushed fix and updated PR description with local repro. Also added note about Netlify env var `NETLIFY_USE_TMP=true` fallback.
Jamie: LGTM from docs side once CI passes. @Devon can you double-check the snippet formatting? :eyes:
Devon: quick pass done, looks fine. small nit about fenced code language — I'll add that to a follow-up. :sparkles:
Alex: thanks all, will merge in the morning window. :shipit:
netlify-bot: New deploy queued for site redwood-docs — deploy id: 5fabcd123 (status: succeeded)
